text:
maya (Support): forwarding an urgent customer report — they see repeated JSON-mode parse failures when sending a batched request with nested arrays, plus latency spikes on retries. error from our API: "invalid_json: parse error at item 2: unexpected extra key "debug_info" in nested object"

jackie (Customer Success): Customer org is on Dedicated. They said the payload used to work, started after a client SDK bump. Sending their example below (redacted).

maya (Support): customer payload (redacted ids) — note the nested array under "events":
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-x-structured",
  "json_mode": "structured",
  "items": [
    {"id": "a1", "user_id": "u-10", "events": [{"type":"click","ts":168000},{"type":"view","ts":169000}]},
    {"id": "a2", "events": [{"type":"click","ts":168500, "debug_info": {"sdk":"1.4.2"}}]},
    {"id": "a3", "user_id": "u-12", "events": [{"type":"purchase","ts":170000}]}
  ]
}
```

maya (Support): note item a2 is missing top-level `user_id` and includes an extra nested key `debug_info`. The API returns a hard validation error instead of accepting the extra nested key or returning item-level error info. Customer says this breaks their streaming handler because when client retries they hit a latency spike and eventual 429s.

sam (Eng): thanks — can you paste the raw request headers they used and the exact server error log lines? need to know if this hits our streaming parser boundary or the post-parse schema validator.

maya (Support): headers they provided: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: application/json`, `Connection: keep-alive`. They are using our SDK which enables chunked streaming by default. Server log (sanitized):
```
ERROR validate_request: schema_validation_failed path=items[1].events[0].debug_info unexpected_property
DEBUG parser: chunked_stream received 2 chunks, last chunk size 128
ERROR jsonmode_handler: aborting parse -> invalid_json at index 1
```

sam (Eng): this looks like two problems interacting: (1) the validator currently rejects unknown nested properties (we intended for strict schemas), (2) when requests are chunked the streaming parser sometimes delivers a partial object to the validator that triggers confusing top-level failures. Repro plan: send equivalent payload with and without `debug_info`, and reproduce with `--no-chunked` and `--chunked`. Can you repro locally and paste curl?

maya (Support): repro curl we ran:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '@sample.json'
# sample.json is the payload above
```
We also tried piping with chunked: `cat sample.json | curl -v -H ... --data-binary @- https://...` — that produced the same invalid_json error consistently.

oncall-ops: pinged for visibility — could be regression from the stricter validator roll last week.

sam (Eng): quick mitigation: I can push a small validator config flip to allow unknownProperties in nested objects for json_mode=structured for the next 30 minutes (non-breaking), but we need a proper fix: (A) ensure streaming parser completes object assembly before validation, (B) update SDK docs to recommend sending full items (or upgrade to SDK >=1.5 which will buffer per-item), (C) add a per-tenant toggle to be tolerant of extra keys.

maya (Support): customer asked whether they should strip `debug_info` on their side for now. They prefer a server-side fix.

sam (Eng): proceeding with temporary flip. I will: 1) enable allowUnknownNested=true for their org id on validation config, 2) add an alert if validator drops to strict mode. Posting rollout cmd now.

inc-bot: Incident created INC-2026: temporary-tolerance-for-jsonmode-unknown-keys for org acme-dedicated (owner: sam).

oncall-ops: patch deployed to the validation service cluster canary -> prod in 7m, monitoring for error rate and latency.

maya (Support): updated customer — they confirmed immediate success after the patch (no more invalid_json) but asked for root cause and long-term plan.

sam (Eng): root cause summary I will add to ticket: validator was made strict and rejects unknown nested keys; combined with chunked streaming boundary behaviour this resulted in earlier-than-expected validation runs on partially-assembled objects. Long-term plan: change parser to always assemble complete JSON items before schema validation, add schema compatibility mode per-tenant, and improve SDK to buffer per-item when streaming. I'll add an engineering task and link in thread.

jackie (Customer Success): I'll schedule a post-mortem call with the customer and send them the mitigation timeline + roadmap.

maya (Support): resolution: temporary config flip applied, customer verified, eng tasks created. Leaving this thread open until parser fix is shipped. :white_check_mark:
